sources.supported_claim: Endogenously tagged STIP1 affinity capture from human HEK293T cells co-recovers HSPA8 by IP-MS.
sources.model_system: Human HEK293T cells with CRISPR split-mNeonGreen2-tagged STIP1; digitonin-solubilized lysate, anti-tag IP-MS in biological triplicate.
limitations: IP-MS co-recovery after lysis supports association in the captured material; it does not establish direct binding or native in-cell contact.
STIP1 was the assay bait and HSPA8 the measured prey; this does not assign a biological direction.
This study did not measure HSP90 client capture, HSPA8-to-HSP90 transfer, or cycle-stage timing. The displayed stage is unchanged model context.
The OpenCell data projection and this publication are one experimental source, not independent replications.
